movelist.name: Play Nice
movelist.effect: Play Nice lowers the target’s Attack by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Yawn
movelist.effect: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

movelist.name: Lick
movelist.effect: Lick Paralyzes the target on 15+ during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Incinerate
movelist.effect: If a target is holding a Held Item or Main or Off- Hand item, they must either drop it immediately or lose a Tick of Hit Points. This may only cause a target to lose at most one Tick of Hit Points, no matter how many items they were holding.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.effect: The user uses the Move “Follow Me” as if it was on their Move List, and their Evasion is raised by +2 until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.effect: The user may have up to three Food Buffs at once, use up to three Food Buffs per Scene, and may eat two refreshments per half hour.
